requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: Both partners are the same molecule differing by one electron on a metal-dominated orbital; the def2-SVP to def2-TZVP differential on such a difference is usually a few tens of meV, and the prior goal named exactly this as the unmeasured component of its 0.25 V asserted uncertainty.
requested_observable_declarations.failure_update_rule: If |basis shift| exceeds 0.05 V, the SVP Gibbs couple is not defensible as the delivered value: the basis-corrected couple becomes the delivery and the measured shift is carried as an evidence-backed uncertainty component rather than an asserted one.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: The shift in the +1/0 couple, in volts, produced by re-evaluating both redox partners at def2-TZVP instead of def2-SVP on their own def2-SVP geometries.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: This workspace has already delivered -0.4727 V for the same couple at PBE0-D3BJ/def2-SVP + CPCM(MeCN) from Gibbs free energies of the validated neutral and doublet-cation minima; a thiolate-rich Ni(II)/Ni(III) pair with two alkyl phosphines sits well below Fc+/Fc.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: The one-electron +1/0 oxidation potential of the PMe3 model complex [Ni(SMe)2(PMe3)2]+/0 in acetonitrile, on the ferrocenium/ferrocene scale, as a best estimate from the registered and newly computed evidence.
requested_observable_declarations.tolerance_basis: Task words: 'a potential versus ferrocene in acetonitrile good to about plus or minus 0.2 V, which is enough to choose among those three oxidants'.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: This workspace delivered 0.2191 eV from the two validated def2-SVP/CPCM minima; a strong-field S2P2 donor set should keep the low-spin doublet below the quartet, but the quartet is not far enough away to dismiss without computing it.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Gibbs free energy of the relaxed quartet cation minus that of the relaxed doublet cation of the PMe3 model complex at 298.15 K, i.e. whether the quartet is competitive with the doublet.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: A d7 Ni(III) centre in a square-planar S2P2 field puts most of the single hole in a metal-centred orbital, with delocalisation onto the two thiolates; this workspace has already delivered 0.809 (Mulliken) and 0.787 (Loewdin) for the same result.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Mulliken spin population on the nickel atom of the relaxed doublet cation of the PMe3 model complex, i.e. how much of the unpaired electron the metal carries.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: Thiolate S 3p orbitals mix strongly with the Ni d manifold, so each sulfur carries a fraction of the hole; the same result previously gave 0.118.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Mulliken spin population on the first thiolate sulfur of the relaxed doublet cation of the PMe3 model complex.

requested_observable_declarations.expectation_basis: The two thiolates are symmetry-equivalent in the trans square-planar arrangement, so the second sulfur should match the first to within relaxation asymmetry; the same result previously gave 0.118.
requested_observable_declarations.meaning: Mulliken spin population on the second thiolate sulfur of the relaxed doublet cation of the PMe3 model complex.
